title: selenicereus ocamponis
intro: Selenicereus ocamponis, commonly known as night-blooming cereus, is a species of cactus in the genus Selenicereus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selenicereus ocamponis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
